trends.name: Binance hack withdrawals and asset recovery
trends.why: Multiple outlets across continents report phased withdrawals and asset replenishment after a $6.3B breach, affecting global crypto markets.

trends.name: OPEC+ maintains oil output targets
trends.why: Key energy policy decision reported by Asia and MENA outlets, influencing global oil prices and supply expectations.

trends.name: Nigeria’s digital economy faces DNS security risks
trends.why: High‑profile cyber incidents reported by multiple Nigerian outlets, underscoring cybersecurity vulnerabilities in emerging digital markets.

trends.name: Egypt’s fuel price decision and distribution oversight
trends.why: Central bank rate hike and new electronic oversight system reported, affecting consumer prices and market liquidity.

trends.name: Morocco’s MINURSO exit and Sahara diplomacy
trends.why: Multiple African outlets cover the UN mandate lapse and Morocco’s diplomatic gains, influencing regional geopolitics.

trends.name: UAE‑Iran war threat escalation
trends.why: UAE’s diplomatic stance amid rising tensions reported, affecting regional security and energy markets.

trends.name: India’s GST reforms for small e‑commerce sellers
trends.why: New registration and refund rules reported, impacting the growth of India’s digital commerce sector.

trends.name: South Korea’s export growth surge
trends.why: Record export increase reported, reflecting robust manufacturing and technology sectors, influencing global supply chains.
